name: Giant Sequoia Library Carved into a Living Mountain
description: A massive library carved inside a living sequoia mountain, tunnels of wood and stone, shelves of stone, sunlight streams through a natural opening, mist inside.
prompt: Huge library carved within a living giant sequoia mountain, stone shelves winding through tree trunk, natural light streaming through an opening in the mountain, mist curling inside, ancient forest atmosphere, ultra-detailed, epic scale.
caption: Enter a library that grows taller than any building 🌲📖 Let the ancient tree house your stories.
